errors.evidence: In the description of the light gray line ("Durchschnittliches Brutto-Gebot Gewinner"), it is stated that the line remains constant until a bonus amount of 0.3. However, the figure shows the line is only constant from 0 to 0.2, after which it starts to rise.

In the description of the dark gray line ("Durchschnittliches Netto-Gebot Gewinner"), it is stated that the line remains constant until a bonus amount of 0.3. However, the figure shows the line is only constant from 0 to 0.2, after which it starts to fall. At a bonus amount of 0.3, the value has already dropped to 5.0.

In the description of the purple line ("Durchschnittliche Stromgestehungskosten Gewinner"), it is stated that the line remains constant until a bonus amount of 0.3. However, the figure shows the line is only constant from 0 to 0.2, after which it starts to rise. At a bonus amount of 0.3, the value has already risen to 5.0 from its starting value of 4.9.
